bio.text: Steven Welzer is the Green Party candidate for New Jersey's 3rd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
WHYY describes him as a retired computer technician with the state judiciary who lives in East Windsor.
According to WHYY, he ran for governor in 2013 as the Green Party's candidate and is a member of the editorial board of the New Green Horizons webzine.
